notes.title: Try our demo, available now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022713/4fbfa12df7d89b81067aa87fde3811cf0ca61748.png[/img]

Hi everyone! We had a blast this weekend at Portland Retro Game Expo, and we're excited to share our demo with everyone.

To download, please look toward the right hand side and click "Download Demo". This should allow the game to download to your PC.

We hope to add the shop, custom name input, and more storylines in the near future.

Please send us all the feedback you like!

Thank you so much for your interest and support!
-Cerise & Alex

notes.title: Demo Available September 15th!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45022713/e43cb212f55a4e4e23f74571bf9297b17890dc55.png[/img]

Hi everyone! We are very excited and on track for our demo, which we plan to release on September 15th. Please keep in mind this demo is only a piece of the wonderful adventure you’ll go on in the full release of Red Thread. 

Our team is working diligently every day, and we will release plenty of updates and patches as we head toward the full release (which we hope to have in January 2025!).

Thanks so much for playing our demo, we can’t wait to hear your feedback.
